spans.s: जहक m. 1. Time; 2. a child; 3. the slough of a snake.

जहत्-लक्षणा, -स्वार्था f. another name of लक्षणलक्षणा which consists in using a word not in its primary sense but in one which has some connection with the primary sense, e.g. गंगायां घोषः (where गंगा loses its primary sense and means गंगातट). Cf. अजहत्स्वार्था.

जह्नु m. Name of an ancient king, who adopted the river Gaṅgā as his daughter.
